full.text: When a cardiac impulse passes through the heart, elec trical current also spreads from the heart into the adja cent tissues surrounding the heart. A small portion of the current spreads all the way to the surface of the body. If electrodes are placed on the skin on opposite sides of the heart, electrical potentials generated by the current can be recorded; the recording is known as an _electrocardio gram_ (ECG). A normal ECG for two beats of the heart is shown in **Figure 11-1**.
WAVEFORMS OF THE NORMAL ELECTROCARDIOGRAM
The normal ECG (see **Figure 11-1**) is composed of a P wave, a QRS complex, and a T wave. The QRS complex is often, but not always, three separate waves: the Q wave, the R wave, and the S wave.

The _P wave_ is caused by electrical potentials generated when the atria depolarize before atrial contraction begins. The _QRS complex_ is caused by potentials generated when the ventricles depolarize before contraction—that is, as the depolarization wave spreads through the ventricles. There fore, both the P wave and the components of the QRS com plex are _depolarization waves_.

The _T wave_ is caused by potentials generated as the ven tricles recover from depolarization. This process normally occurs in ventricular muscle 0.25 to 0.35 second after depo larization. The T wave is known as a _repolarization wave_.

Thus, the ECG is composed of both depolarization and repolarization waves. The principles of depolarization and repolarization are discussed in Chapter 5. The dis tinction between depolarization waves and repolarization waves is so important in electrocardiography that further clarification is necessary.
CARDIAC DEPOLARIZATION WAVES VERSUS REPOLARIZATION WAVES

**Figure 11-2** shows a single cardiac muscle fiber in four stages of depolarization and repolarization, with the color red designating depolarization. During depolarization, the normal negative potential inside the fiber reverses and becomes slightly positive inside and negative outside.

In **Figure 11-2A**, depolarization, demonstrated by red positive charges inside and red negative charges outside, is traveling from left to right. The first half of the fiber has already depolarized while the remaining half is still polar ized. Therefore, the left electrode on the outside of the fiber is in an area of negativity, and the right electrode is in an area of positivity, which causes the meter to record positively. To the right of the muscle fiber is shown a record of changes in potential between the two electrodes, as recorded by a highspeed recording meter. Note that when depolarization has reached the halfway mark in **Figure 11-2A**, the recording on the right has risen to a maximum positive value.

In **Figure 11-2B**, depolarization has extended over the entire muscle fiber, and the recording to the right has returned to the zero baseline because both electrodes are now in areas of equal negativity. The completed wave is a depolarization wave because it results from the spread of depolarization along the muscle fiber membrane.

**Figure 11-2C** shows halfway repolarization of the same muscle fiber, with positivity returning to the outside of the fiber. At this point, the left electrode is in an area of positivity, and the right electrode is in an area of negativ ity. This polarity is opposite to the polarity in **Figure 112A**. Consequently, the recording, as shown to the right, becomes negative.

In **Figure 11-2D**, the muscle fiber has completely repolarized, and both electrodes are now in areas of posi tivity so that no potential difference is recorded between them. Thus, in the recording on the right, the potential returns once more to zero. This completed negative wave is a repolarization wave because it results from the spread of repolarization along the muscle fiber membrane.

The monophasic action potential of ventricular muscle, discussed in Chapter 10, normally lasts between 0.25 and 0.35 second. The top part of **Figure 11-3** shows a monophasic action potential re corded from a microelectrode inserted into the inside of a single ventricular muscle fiber. The upsweep of this action potential is caused by depolarization, and the return of the potential to the baseline is caused by repolarization.

full.text: The lower half of **Figure 11-3** shows a simultaneous recording of the ECG from this same ventricle. Note that the QRS waves appear at the beginning of the monopha sic action potential, and the T wave appears at the end. Note especially that _no potential is recorded in the ECG when the ventricular muscle is either completely polarized or completely depolarized_. Only when the muscle is partly polarized and partly depolarized does current flow from one part of the ventricles to another part, and therefore current also flows to the surface of the body to produce the ECG.
RELATIONSHIP OF ATRIAL AND VENTRICULAR CONTRACTION TO THE WAVES OF THE ELECTROCARDIOGRAM

Before contraction of muscle can occur, depolarization must spread through the muscle to initiate the chemical processes of contraction. Refer again to **Figure 11-1**; the P wave occurs at the beginning of contraction of the atria, and the QRS complex of waves occurs at the beginning of contraction of the ventricles. The ventricles remain con tracted until after repolarization has occurred—that is, until after the end of the T wave.

The atria repolarize about 0.15 to 0.20 second after ter mination of the P wave, which is also approximately when the QRS complex is being recorded in the ECG. There fore, the atrial repolarization wave, known as the _atrial T wave_, is usually obscured by the much larger QRS com plex. For this reason, an atrial T wave is seldom observed on the ECG.

The ventricular repolarization wave is the T wave of the normal ECG. Ordinarily, ventricular muscle begins to repolarize in some fibers about 0.20 second after the beginning of the depolarization wave (the QRS complex), but in many other fibers, it takes as long as 0.35 second. Thus, the process of ventricular repolarization extends over a long period, about 0.15 second. For this reason, the T wave in the normal ECG is a prolonged wave, but the voltage of the T wave is considerably less than the volt age of the QRS complex, partly because of its prolonged length.
ELECTROCARDIOGRAPHIC CALIBRATION AND DISPLAY

All recordings of ECGs are made with appropriate cali bration lines on the display grid. Historically, ECGs were recorded electronically and printed onto paper; ECGs are now usually displayed digitally. As shown in **Figure 11-1**, the horizontal calibration lines are arranged so that 10 of the small line divisions upward or downward in the standard ECG represent 1 millivolt, with positivity in the upward direction and negativity in the downward direction.

The vertical lines on the ECG are time calibration lines. A typical ECG is run at a speed of 25 millimeters per sec ond, although faster speeds are sometimes used. Therefore, each 25 millimeters in the horizontal direction is 1 second, and each 5-millimeter segment, indicated by the dark ver tical lines, represents 0.20 second. The 0.20-second inter vals are then broken into five smaller intervals by thin lines, each of which represents 0.04 second.

The re corded voltages of the waves in the normal ECG depend on the manner in which the electrodes are applied to the surface of the body and how close the electrodes are to the heart. When one electrode is placed directly over the ven tricles, and a second electrode is placed elsewhere on the body remote from the heart, the voltage of the QRS com plex may be as high as 3 to 4 millivolts. Even this voltage is small in comparison with the monophasic action poten tial of 110 millivolts recorded directly at the heart muscle membrane. When ECGs are recorded from electrodes on the two arms or on one arm and one leg, the voltage of the QRS complex usually is 1.0 to 1.5 millivolts from the top of the R wave to the bottom of the S wave, the voltage of the P wave is between 0.1 and 0.3 millivolts, and the volt age of the T wave is between 0.2 and 0.3 millivolts.

The time between the beginning of the P wave and the beginning of the QRS complex is the interval between the beginning of electrical excitation of the atria and the beginning of excitation of the ventricles. This period is called the _P-Q interval_. The normal P-Q interval is about 0.16 second. (Often, this interval is called the _P-R interval_ because the Q wave is likely to be ab sent.) The P-R interval shortens at faster heart rates due to increased sympathetic or decreased parasympathetic activity, which increase atrioventricular node conduction speed. Conversely, the P-R interval lengthens with slower heart rates as a consequence of slower atrioventricular nodal conduction caused by increased parasympathetic tone or withdrawal of sympathetic activity.

Contraction of the ventricle lasts almost from the beginning of the Q wave (or R wave, if the Q wave is absent) to the end of the T wave. This interval is called the _Q-T interval_ and ordinarily is about 0.35 second.

The rate of the heartbeat can be determined easily from an ECG because the heart rate is the reciprocal of the time interval between two successive heartbeats (the R-R interval). If the interval between two beats as deter mined from the time calibration lines is 1 second, the heart rate is 60 beats/min. The normal interval between two successive QRS complexes in an adult is about 0.83 second, which is a heart rate of 60/0.83 times/min, or 72 beats/min.

full.text: FLOW OF CURRENT AROUND THE HEART DURING THE CARDIAC CYCLE
Recording Electrical Potentials from a Partially Depolarized Mass of Syncytial Cardiac Muscle

**Figure 11-4** shows a syncytial mass of cardiac muscle that has been stimulated at its most central point. Before stimu lation, all the exteriors of the muscle cells had been positive, and the interiors had been negative. For reasons presented in Chapter 5 in the discussion of membrane potentials, as soon as an area of cardiac syncytium becomes depolarized, negative charges leak to the outsides of the depolarized muscle fibers, making this part of the surface electronega tive, as represented by the minus signs in **Figure 11-4**. The remaining surface of the heart, which is still polarized, is represented by the plus signs. Therefore, a meter connected with its negative terminal on the area of depolarization and its positive terminal on one of the still polarized areas, as shown to the right in the figure, records positively.

Two other electrode placements and meter readings are also demonstrated in **Figure 11-4**. These placements and readings should be studied carefully, and the reader should be able to explain the causes of the respective meter readings. Because the depolarization spreads in all direc tions through the heart, the potential differences shown in the figure persist for only a few thousandths of a sec ond, and the actual voltage measurements can be accom plished only with a high-speed recording apparatus.
Flow of Electrical Currents in the Chest Around the Heart

**Figure 11-5** shows the ventricular muscle lying within the chest. Even the lungs, although mostly filled with air, con duct electricity to a surprising extent, and fluids in other tissues surrounding the heart conduct electricity even more easily. Therefore, the heart is actually suspended in a conductive medium. When one portion of the ventricles depolarizes and therefore becomes electronegative with respect to the remainder, electrical current flows from the depolarized area to the polarized area in large circuitous routes, as noted in the figure.

It should be recalled from the discussion of the Pur kinje system in Chapter 10 that the cardiac impulse first arrives in the ventricles in the septum and shortly there after spreads to the inside surfaces of the remainder of the ventricles, as shown by the red areas and the negative signs in **Figure 11-5**. This process provides electronega tivity on the insides of the ventricles and electropositivity on the outer walls of the ventricles, with electrical cur rent flowing through the fluids surrounding the ventricles along elliptical paths, as demonstrated by the curving arrows in the figure. If one algebraically averages all the lines of current flow (the elliptical lines), _the average cur rent flow occurs with negativity toward the base of the heart and with positivity toward the apex_.

During most of the remainder of the depolarization process, current also continues to flow in this same direc tion, whereas depolarization spreads from the endocardial surface outward through the ventricular muscle mass. Then, immediately before depolarization has completed its course through the ventricles, the average direction of current flow reverses for about 0.01 second, flowing from the ventricular apex toward the base, because the last part of the heart to become depolarized is the outer walls of the ventricles near the base of the heart.

_Thus, in normal heart ventricles, current flows from negative to positive primarily in the direction from the base of the heart toward the apex_ during almost the entire cycle of depolarization, except at the very end. If a meter is connected to electrodes on the surface of the body, as shown in **Figure 11-5**, the electrode nearer the base will be negative, whereas the electrode nearer the apex will be positive, and the recording meter will show a positive recording in the ECG.
ELECTROCARDIOGRAPHIC LEADS
Three Standard Bipolar Limb Leads
**Figure 11-6** shows electrical connections between the patient’s limbs and the electrocardiograph for recording

ECGs from the so-called _standard bipolar limb leads._ The term _bipolar_ means that the ECG is recorded from two electrodes located on different sides of the heart—in this case, on the limbs. Thus, a lead is not a single wire con necting from the body but a combination of two wires and their electrodes to make a complete circuit between the body and the electrocardiograph. The electrocardiograph in each case is represented by an electrical meter in the diagram, although the actual electrocardiograph is a highspeed, computer-based system with an electronic display.

In recording limb lead I, the negative terminal of the electrocardiograph is connected to the right arm, and the positive terminal is connected to the left arm. There fore, when the point where the right arm connects to the chest is electronegative with respect to the point where the left arm connects, the electrocardiograph records positively—that is, above the zero-voltage line in the ECG. When the opposite is true, the electrocardiograph records below the line.

To record limb lead II, the negative terminal of the electrocardiograph is connected to the right arm and the positive terminal is connected to the left leg. There fore, when the right arm is negative with respect to the left leg, the electrocardiograph records positively.

To record limb lead III, the negative terminal of the electrocardiograph is connected to the left arm, and the positive terminal is connected to the left leg. This configuration means that the electrocardiograph records positively when the left arm is negative with respect to the left leg.

In **Figure 11-6**, the triangle, called _Einthoven’s triangle_, is drawn around the area of the heart. This triangle illustrates that the two arms and left leg form apices of a triangle surrounding the heart. The two apices at the upper part of the triangle represent the points at which the two arms connect electrically with the fluids around the heart, and the lower apex is the point at which the left leg connects with the fluids.
Einthoven’s law states that if the ECGs are recorded simultaneously with the three limb leads, the sum of the potentials recorded in leads I and III will equal the potential in lead II:

In other words, if the electrical potentials of any two of the three bipolar limb electrocardiographic leads are known at any given instant, the third one can be deter mined by simply summing the first two. Note, however, that the positive and negative signs of the different leads must be observed when making this summation.
For instance, let us assume that momentarily, as noted in **Figure 11-6**, the right arm is −0.2 millivolts (negative)

with respect to the average potential in the body, the left arm is +0.3 millivolts (positive), and the left leg is +1.0 millivolts (positive). Observing the meters in the figure, one can see that lead I records a positive potential of +0.5 millivolts because this is the difference between the −0.2 millivolts on the right arm and the +0.3 millivolts on the left arm. Similarly, lead III records a positive potential of +0.7 millivolts, and lead II records a positive potential of +1.2 millivolts because these are the instantaneous poten tial differences between the respective pairs of limbs.

Now, note that the sum of the voltages in leads I and III equals the voltage in lead II; that is, 0.5 plus 0.7 equals 1.2. Mathematically, this principle, called Einthoven’s law, holds true at any given instant while the three “standard” bipolar ECGs are being recorded.

**Figure 11-7** shows recordings of the ECGs in leads I, II, and III. It is obvious that the ECGs in these three leads are similar to one another because they all record positive P waves and positive T waves, and the major portion of the QRS complex is also positive in each ECG. On analysis of the three ECGs, it can be shown, with careful measurements and proper observance of polarities, that at any given instant, the sum of the potentials in leads I and III equals the potential in lead II, thus illustrating the validity of Einthoven’s law.

full.text: Because the recordings from all the bipolar limb leads are similar to one another, it does not mat ter greatly which lead is recorded when one wants to diagnose different cardiac arrhythmias, because diagnosis of arrhythmias depends mainly on the time relationships between the different waves of the car diac cycle. However, when one wants to diagnose dam age in the ventricular or atrial muscle or in the Purkinje conducting system, it matters greatly which leads are recorded, because abnormalities of cardiac muscle contraction or cardiac impulse conduction change the patterns of the ECGs markedly in some leads yet may not affect other leads. Electrocardiographic interpreta tion of these two types of conditions—cardiac myopa thies and cardiac arrhythmias—is discussed separately in Chapters 12 and 13.

Often ECGs are recorded with one electrode placed on the anterior surface of the chest directly over the heart at one of the points shown in **Figure 11-8**. This electrode is connected to the positive terminal of the electrocardiograph, and the negative electrode, called the _indifferent electrode_ or _Wilson central terminal,_ is connected through equal electrical resistances to the right arm, left arm, and left leg all at the same time, as also shown in the figure. Usually, six standard chest leads are recorded, one at a time, from the anterior chest wall, with the chest electrode being placed sequentially at the six points shown in the diagram. The different recordings are known as leads V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, and V6.

**Figure 11-9** illustrates the ECGs of the healthy heart as recorded from these six standard chest leads. Because the heart surfaces are close to the chest wall, each chest lead records mainly the electrical potential of the cardiac musculature immediately beneath the electrode. There fore, relatively minute abnormalities in the ventricles, particularly in the anterior ventricular wall, can cause marked changes in the ECGs recorded from individual chest leads.

In leads V1 and V2, the QRS recordings of the normal heart are mainly negative because, as shown in **Figure 11-8**, the chest electrode in these leads is closer to the base of the heart than to the apex, and the base of the heart is the direction of electronegativity during most of the ventricular depolarization process. Conversely, the QRS complexes in leads V4, V5, and V6 are mainly positive because the chest electrode in these leads is closer to the heart apex, which is the direction of electropositivity dur ing most of depolarization.
Augmented Limb Leads

Another system of leads in wide use is the _augmented limb leads_. In this type of recording, two of the limbs are connected through electrical resistances to the neg ative terminal of the electrocardiograph, and the third limb is connected to the positive terminal. When the positive terminal is on the right arm, the lead is known as the aVR lead; when on the left arm, it is known as the aVL lead; and when on the left leg, it is known as the aVF lead.

Normal recordings of the augmented limb leads are shown in **Figure 11-10**. They are all similar to the stan dard limb lead recordings, except that the recording from the aVR lead is inverted. (Why does this inversion occur? Study the polarity connections to the electrocardiograph to determine the answer to this question.)

Leads are typically displayed into three groupings as in **Fig ure 11-11**: the standard bipolar limb leads (I, II, III) fol lowed by the augmented leads (aVR, aVL, and aVF) and then the precordial leads (V1–V6).

Standard ECGs provide an assessment of cardiac electri cal events over a brief duration, usually while the patient is resting. In conditions associated with infrequent but im portant abnormalities of cardiac rhythms, it may be useful to examine the ECG over a longer period, thereby permit ting evaluation of changing cardiac electrical phenomena that are transient and may be missed with a standard rest ing ECG. Extending the ECG to allow assessment of car diac electrical events while the patient is ambulating during normal daily activities is called _ambulatory electrocardiog raphy_.

Ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring is typi cally used when a patient demonstrates symptoms that are thought to be caused by transient arrhythmias or other transient cardiac abnormalities. These symptoms may in clude chest pain, syncope (fainting) or near syncope, diz ziness, and irregular heartbeats (palpitations). The crucial information needed to diagnose serious transient arrhyth mias or other cardiac conditions is a recording of an ECG during the precise time that the symptom is occurring. These devices can also be used to detect asymptomatic cardiac arrhythmias such as atrial fibrillation that may in crease the risk of embolus formation, which can, in turn, cause strokes. Because the daily variability in the frequency of arrhythmias is substantial, detection often requires am bulatory electrocardiographic monitoring throughout the day.

There are several categories of ambulatory electrocar diographic recorders. Continuous recorders (Holter moni tors), are typically used for 24 to 48 hours to investigate the relationship of symptoms and electrocardiographic events that are likely to occur within that time frame. Intermittent recorders are used for longer periods (weeks to months) to provide brief intermittent recordings for detection of events that occur infrequently; these recordings are usually initiated by the patient when experiencing symptoms. In some cases, a small device, about the size of a large paper clip and called an _implantable loop recorder_, is implanted just under the skin in the chest to monitor the heart’s elec trical activity continuously for as long as 2 to 3 years. The device can be programmed to initiate a recording when the heart rate falls below, or rises above, a predetermined level, or it can be activated manually by the patient when a symp tom such as dizziness occurs. Improvements in solid-state digital technology and recorders equipped with micropro cessors now permit continuous or intermittent transmis sion of digital electrocardiographic data over telephone lines, and sophisticated software systems provide rapid on line computerized analysis of the data as they are acquired. Newer wearable devices, including watches or hand-held electrocardiographic monitoring devices, are also being de veloped for home-based heart rhythm monitoring.

ch11-f0.text: Yurak impulsi yurak böylab ötganda elektr toki yurakdan uni örab turgan qöşni töqimalarga ham tarqaladi. Tokning kiçik bir qismi tana yuzasigaça yetib boradi. Agar elektrodlar terining yurakka nisbatan qarama-qarşi tomonlariga qöyilsa, şu tok hosil qiladigan elektr potensiallarini qayd qiliş mumkin; bu yozuv _elektrokardiogramma_ (EKG) deb ataladi. Yurakning ikki qisqarişiga mos normal EKG **Rasm 11-1** da körsatilgan.

ch11-f3.text: Normal EKG (qarang: **Rasm 11-1**) P tişçasi, QRS kompleksi va T tişçasidan iborat. QRS kompleksi köpinça, ammo har doim emas, uçta alohida tişçadan — Q, R va S tişçalaridan taşkil topadi.

ch11-f4.text: _P tişçasi_ bölmaçalar qisqarişi boşlanişidan oldin ular depolyarizatsiyalanganda hosil böladigan elektr potensiallari tufayli yuzaga keladi. _QRS kompleksi_ qorinçalar qisqarişidan oldin ular depolyarizatsiyalanganda, ya’ni depolyarizatsiya tölqini qorinçalar böylab tarqalganda hosil böladigan potensiallar tufayli yuzaga keladi. Şuning uçun P tişçasi ham, QRS kompleksining tarkibiy qismlari ham _depolyarizatsiya tölqinlari_ hisoblanadi.

ch11-f5.text: _T tişçasi_ qorinçalar depolyarizatsiyadan tiklanayotganda hosil böladigan potensiallar tufayli yuzaga keladi. Bu jarayon qorinça muskulida odatda depolyarizatsiyadan 0,25–0,35 soniya ötgaç keçadi. T tişçasi _repolyarizatsiya tölqini_ deb ataladi.

ch11-f6.text: Şunday qilib, EKG depolyarizatsiya va repolyarizatsiya tölqinlaridan taşkil topgan. Depolyarizatsiya va repolyarizatsiya tamoyillari 5-bobda muhokama qilingan. Elektrokardiografiyada depolyarizatsiya tölqinlari bilan repolyarizatsiya tölqinlari örtasidagi farq şu qadar muhimki, uni yanada aniqlaştiriş zarur.

ch11-f7.text: Yurakning depolyarizatsiya tölqinlari va repolyarizatsiya tölqinlari

ch11-f8.text: **Rasm 11-2** da yurakning bitta muskul tolasi depolyarizatsiya va repolyarizatsiyaning tört bosqiçida körsatilgan; qizil rang depolyarizatsiyani bildiradi. Depolyarizatsiya paytida tola içidagi normal manfiy potensial teskarisiga özgaradi: içkarisi biroz musbat, taşqarisi esa manfiy bölib qoladi.

ch11-f10.text: **Rasm 11-2A** da içkaridagi qizil musbat zaryadlar va taşqaridagi qizil manfiy zaryadlar bilan körsatilgan depolyarizatsiya çapdan öngga tarqalmoqda. Tolaning birinçi yarmi allaqaçon depolyarizatsiyalangan, qolgan yarmi esa hali qutblangan holatda. Şuning uçun tola taşqarisidagi çap elektrod manfiylik sohasida, öng elektrod esa musbatlik sohasida joylaşgan bölib, bu ölçov asbobining musbat qayd etişiga sabab böladi. Muskul tolasining öng tomonida yuqori tezlikda qayd qiluvçi asbob yozib olgan ikki elektrod orasidagi potensial özgarişlari körsatilgan. E’tibor bering: **Rasm 11-2A** da depolyarizatsiya tolaning yarmiga yetganda öngdagi yozuv maksimal musbat qiymatgaça kötarilgan.

ch11-f11.text: **Rasm 11-2B** da depolyarizatsiya butun muskul tolasiga tarqalgan va öngdagi yozuv nol izoliniyaga qaytgan, çunki endi ikkala elektrod ham bir xil manfiylik sohalarida joylaşgan. Tugallangan tölqin depolyarizatsiya tölqinidir, çunki u depolyarizatsiyaning muskul tolasi membranasi böylab tarqalişi natijasida yuzaga keladi.

ch11-f12.text: **Rasm 11-2C** da öşa muskul tolasining yarmigaça repolyarizatsiyalangani körsatilgan: tola taşqarisiga musbatlik qaytmoqda. Bu nuqtada çap elektrod musbatlik sohasida, öng elektrod esa manfiylik sohasida joylaşgan. Bu qutblaniş **Rasm 11-2A** dagi qutblanişga qarama-qarşi. Natijada öngda körsatilganidek, yozuv manfiy böladi.

ch11-f13.text: **Rasm 11-2D** da muskul tolasi töliq repolyarizatsiyalangan va endi ikkala elektrod ham musbatlik sohalarida joylaşgan, şuning uçun ular orasida potensiallar farqi qayd qilinmaydi. Şunday qilib, öngdagi yozuvda potensial yana nolga qaytadi. Bu tugallangan manfiy tölqin repolyarizatsiya tölqinidir, çunki u repolyarizatsiyaning muskul tolasi membranasi böylab tarqalişi natijasida yuzaga keladi.

ch11-f14.text: 10-bobda muhokama qilingan qorinça muskulining monofazali harakat potensiali odatda 0,25 dan 0,35 soniyagaça davom etadi. **Rasm 11-3** ning yuqori qismida qorinçaning bitta muskul tolasi içiga kiritilgan mikroelektrod yordamida qayd qilingan monofazali harakat potensiali körsatilgan. Bu harakat potensialining keskin kötarilişi depolyarizatsiya, potensialning izoliniyaga qaytişi esa repolyarizatsiya tufayli yuzaga keladi.
ch11-f14.lead: Qorinça muskulining monofazali harakat potensiali bilan standart elektrokardiogrammadagi QRS va T tişçalarining boğliqligi.

ch11-f16.text: **Rasm 11-3** ning pastki yarmida aynan şu qorinçadan bir vaqtda yozib olingan EKG körsatilgan. E’tibor bering: QRS tişçalari monofazali harakat potensialining boşida, T tişçasi esa oxirida paydo böladi. Ayniqsa şunga e’tibor beringki, _qorinça muskuli töliq qutblangan yoki töliq depolyarizatsiyalangan holatda EKGda heç qanday potensial qayd qilinmaydi_. Faqat muskul qisman qutblangan va qisman depolyarizatsiyalangan holatdagina tok qorinçalarning bir qismidan boşqa qismiga oqadi va şu sababli tok tana yuzasiga ham oqib, EKGni hosil qiladi.

ch11-f17.text: Bölmaçalar va qorinçalar qisqarişining elektrokardiogramma tölqinlari bilan boğliqligi

ch11-f18.text: Muskul qisqarişi yuz berişidan oldin qisqarişning kimyoviy jarayonlarini boşlaş uçun depolyarizatsiya muskul böylab tarqalişi kerak. Yana **Rasm 11-1** ga murojaat qiling: P tişçasi bölmaçalar qisqarişining boşida, QRS tişçalar kompleksi esa qorinçalar qisqarişining boşida yuzaga keladi. Qorinçalar repolyarizatsiya yuz bergunga qadar, ya’ni T tişçasi tugagunga qadar qisqargan holatda qoladi.

ch11-f19.text: Bölmaçalar P tişçasi tugaganidan taxminan 0,15–0,20 soniya ötgaç repolyarizatsiyalanadi; bu taxminan EKGda QRS kompleksi qayd qilinayotgan vaqtga töğri keladi. Şu sababli _bölmaça T tişçasi_ deb ataladigan bölmaçalar repolyarizatsiya tölqini odatda ança katta QRS kompleksi bilan berkilib qoladi. Şuning uçun EKGda bölmaça T tişçasi kamdan-kam körinadi.

ch11-f20.text: Qorinçalar repolyarizatsiya tölqini normal EKGdagi T tişçasidir. Odatda qorinça muskulining ba’zi tolalari depolyarizatsiya tölqini (QRS kompleksi) boşlanganidan taxminan 0,20 soniya ötgaç repolyarizatsiyalana boşlaydi, ammo köplab boşqa tolalarda bu 0,35 soniyagaça çöziladi. Şunday qilib, qorinçalar repolyarizatsiyasi jarayoni uzoq — taxminan 0,15 soniya davom etadi. Şu sababli normal EKGdagi T tişçasi çözilgan tölqin böladi, ammo uning voltaji QRS kompleksining voltajidan ança past, bu qisman uning uzoq davom etişi bilan boğliq.

ch11-f22.text: EKGning barça yozuvlari tasvir törida tegişli kalibrlaş çiziqlari bilan amalga oşiriladi. Ilgari EKG elektron usulda yozib olinib, qoğozga çop etilardi; hozirda EKG odatda raqamli şaklda tasvirlanadi. **Rasm 11-1** da körsatilganidek, gorizontal kalibrlaş çiziqlari şunday joylaşganki, standart EKGda yuqoriga yoki pastga 10 ta kiçik bölinma 1 millivoltga töğri keladi; musbatlik yuqoriga, manfiylik esa pastga yönalgan.

ch11-f23.text: EKGdagi vertikal çiziqlar — vaqtni kalibrlaş çiziqlari. Tipik EKG soniyasiga 25 millimetr tezlikda yoziladi, ba’zan esa yuqoriroq tezliklar ham qöllaniladi. Şuning uçun gorizontal yönalişdagi har 25 millimetr 1 soniyaga, töq vertikal çiziqlar bilan belgilangan har bir 5 millimetrlik bölak esa 0,20 soniyaga töğri keladi. 0,20 soniyalik oraliqlar öz navbatida ingiçka çiziqlar bilan beşta kiçikroq oraliqqa bölingan, ularning har biri 0,04 soniyaga teng.

ch11-f24.text: Normal EKGdagi tişçalarning qayd qilinadigan voltajlari elektrodlarning tana yuzasiga qanday qöyilganiga va elektrodlarning yurakka qançalik yaqinligiga boğliq. Bitta elektrod bevosita qorinçalar ustiga, ikkinçisi esa tananing yurakdan uzoq boşqa joyiga qöyilganda QRS kompleksining voltaji 3–4 millivoltgaça yetişi mumkin. Hatto bu voltaj ham bevosita yurak muskuli membranasida qayd qilinadigan 110 millivoltlik monofazali harakat potensialiga nisbatan kiçik. EKG ikki qoldagi yoki bir qöl va bir oyoqdagi elektrodlardan yozib olinganda QRS kompleksining voltaji R tişçasi çöqqisidan S tişçasi tubigaça odatda 1,0–1,5 millivolt, P tişçasining voltaji 0,1–0,3 millivolt, T tişçasining voltaji esa 0,2–0,3 millivolt böladi.

ch11-f25.text: P tişçasi boşlanişidan QRS kompleksi boşlanişigaça bölgan vaqt bölmaçalarning elektr qözğalişi boşlanişi bilan qorinçalar qözğalişi boşlanişi orasidagi intervaldir. Bu davr _P-Q intervali_ deb ataladi. Normal P-Q intervali taxminan 0,16 soniya. (Köpinça bu interval _P-R intervali_ deb ataladi, çunki Q tişçasi bölmasligi mumkin.) Yurak qisqarişlari tezlaşganda P-R intervali qisqaradi, çunki bunda simpatik faollik ortadi yoki parasimpatik faollik kamayadi va bu atrioventrikulyar tugun orqali ötkaziş tezligini oşiradi. Aksinça, yurak qisqarişlari sekinlaşganda parasimpatik tonusning ortişi yoki simpatik faollikning susayişi tufayli atrioventrikulyar tugun orqali ötkaziş sekinlaşadi va natijada P-R intervali uzayadi.

ch11-f26.text: Qorinçaning qisqarişi deyarli Q tişçasi (agar Q tişçasi bölmasa, R tişçasi) boşlanişidan T tişçasi oxirigaça davom etadi. Bu interval _Q-T intervali_ deb ataladi va odatda taxminan 0,35 soniyani taşkil qiladi.

ch11-f27.text: Yurak uriş çastotasini EKG böyiça oson aniqlaş mumkin, çunki yurak uriş çastotasi ketma-ket ikki yurak qisqarişi orasidagi vaqt oraliğiga (R-R intervaliga) teskari kattalikdir. Agar vaqt kalibrlaş çiziqlari böyiça aniqlangan ikki qisqariş orasidagi interval 1 soniya bölsa, yurak uriş çastotasi daqiqasiga 60 marta böladi. Kattalarda ketma-ket ikki QRS kompleksi orasidagi normal interval taxminan 0,83 soniya, bu esa daqiqasiga 60/0,83 marta, ya’ni daqiqasiga 72 marta yurak urişiga töğri keladi.
ch11-f27.lead: Elektrokardiogramma böyiça yurak qisqarişlari çastotasini aniqlaş.

ch11-f28.text: Yurak sikli davomida yurak atrofida tokning oqişi

ch11-f29.text: Qisman depolyarizatsiyalangan sinsitial yurak muskuli massasidan elektr potensiallarini qayd qiliş

ch11-f30.text: **Rasm 11-4** da eng markaziy nuqtasidan qözğatilgan sinsitial yurak muskuli massasi körsatilgan. Qözğatişdan oldin muskul hujayralarining barça taşqi yuzalari musbat, içki qismlari esa manfiy bölgan. 5-bobda membrana potensiallarini muhokama qilişda keltirilgan sabablarga köra, yurak sinsitiysining biror sohasi depolyarizatsiyalanişi bilanoq manfiy zaryadlar depolyarizatsiyalangan muskul tolalarining taşqi tomoniga sizib çiqadi va **Rasm 11-4** da minus belgilari bilan körsatilganidek, yuzaning bu qismini elektromanfiy qiladi. Yurakning hali qutblangan qolgan yuzasi plyus belgilari bilan körsatilgan. Şuning uçun rasmning öng tomonida körsatilganidek, manfiy qutbi depolyarizatsiya sohasiga, musbat qutbi esa hali qutblangan sohalardan biriga ulangan ölçov asbobi musbat qayd etadi.

ch11-f32.text: **Rasm 11-4** da elektrodlarning yana ikki xil joylaşuvi va asbob körsatkiçlari ham körsatilgan. Bu joylaşuvlar va körsatkiçlarni diqqat bilan örganiş kerak, öquvçi esa tegişli asbob körsatkiçlarining sabablarini tuşuntira olişi lozim. Depolyarizatsiya yurak böylab barça yönalişlarga tarqalgani uçun rasmda körsatilgan potensiallar farqi atigi sekundning bir neça mingdan bir qismi davomida saqlanadi va haqiqiy voltajni ölçaş faqat yuqori tezlikda qayd qiluvçi apparat yordamida amalga oşirilişi mumkin.

ch11-f33.text: Kökrak qafasida yurak atrofida elektr toklarining oqişi

ch11-f34.text: **Rasm 11-5** da kökrak qafasi içida joylaşgan qorinçalar muskuli körsatilgan. Hatto asosan havo bilan tölgan öpkalar ham elektr tokini ajablanarli darajada ötkazadi, yurakni örab turgan boşqa töqimalardagi suyuqliklar esa elektr tokini yanada osonroq ötkazadi. Şuning uçun yurak aslida ötkazuvçi muhitda muallaq turadi. Qorinçalarning bir qismi depolyarizatsiyalanib, qolgan qismiga nisbatan elektromanfiy bölib qolganda, rasmda körsatilganidek, elektr toki depolyarizatsiyalangan sohadan qutblangan sohaga katta aylanma yöllar böylab oqadi.

ch11-f36.text: 10-bobdagi Purkinye tizimi muhokamasidan esda tutiş kerakki, yurak impulsi qorinçalarda avval tösiqqa yetib keladi va undan köp ötmay **Rasm 11-5** da qizil sohalar va manfiy belgilar bilan körsatilganidek, qorinçalarning qolgan qismining içki yuzalariga tarqaladi. Bu jarayon qorinçalarning içki tomonida elektromanfiylikni, qorinçalarning taşqi devorlarida esa elektromusbatlikni yuzaga keltiradi; bunda elektr toki rasmda egri strelkalar bilan körsatilganidek, qorinçalarni örab turgan suyuqliklar orqali ellipssimon yöllar böylab oqadi. Agar tok oqimining barça çiziqlari (ellipssimon çiziqlar) algebraik örtaça qilib olinsa, _tokning örtaça oqimi manfiylik yurak asosi tomonga, musbatlik esa yurak çöqqisi tomonga yönalgan holda keçadi_.

ch11-f37.text: Depolyarizatsiya jarayonining qolgan qismining katta qismida ham tok şu yönalişda oqişda davom etadi, depolyarizatsiya esa endokard yuzasidan taşqariga qarab qorinçalar muskul massasi böylab tarqaladi. Söngra depolyarizatsiya qorinçalar böylab öz yölini tugatişidan bevosita oldin tok oqimining örtaça yönalişi taxminan 0,01 soniyaga teskarisiga özgaradi va qorinçalar çöqqisidan asosga tomon oqadi, çunki yurakning eng oxirgi depolyarizatsiyalanadigan qismi qorinçalarning yurak asosiga yaqin taşqi devorlaridir.

ch11-f38.text: _Şunday qilib, normal yurak qorinçalarida depolyarizatsiyaning deyarli butun sikli davomida, eng oxiridan taşqari, tok manfiydan musbatga asosan yurak asosidan çöqqisi tomonga oqadi_. Agar ölçov asbobi **Rasm 11-5** da körsatilganidek, tana yuzasidagi elektrodlarga ulansa, asosga yaqinroq elektrod manfiy, çöqqiga yaqinroq elektrod esa musbat böladi va qayd qiluvçi asbob EKGda musbat yozuvni körsatadi.

ch11-f41.text: **Rasm 11-6** da bemorning oyoq-qöllari bilan elektrokardiograf örtasidagi elektr ulanişlar körsatilgan; ular

ch11-f43.text: EKGni _standart bipolyar oyoq-qöl ulanişlari_ deb ataladigan ulanişlardan qayd qiliş uçun işlatiladi. _Bipolyar_ atamasi EKG yurakning turli tomonlarida — bu holda oyoq-qöllarda — joylaşgan ikki elektroddan qayd qilinişini bildiradi. Demak, ulaniş tanadan çiquvçi yagona sim emas, balki tana bilan elektrokardiograf örtasida yopiq zanjir hosil qiluvçi ikki sim va ularning elektrodlari birikmasidir. Sxemada har bir holatda elektrokardiograf elektr ölçov asbobi sifatida tasvirlangan, garçi haqiqiy elektrokardiograf elektron displeyga ega yuqori tezlikli kompyuterlaştirilgan tizim bölsa-da.

ch11-f44.text: I oyoq-qöl ulanişini qayd qilişda elektrokardiografning manfiy qutbi öng qölga, musbat qutbi esa çap qölga ulanadi. Şuning uçun öng qöl kökrak qafasiga tutaşgan nuqta çap qöl tutaşgan nuqtaga nisbatan elektromanfiy bölganda elektrokardiograf musbat qayd etadi, ya’ni EKGda nol voltaj çiziğidan yuqorida. Aksinça bölganda elektrokardiograf çiziqdan pastda qayd etadi.

ch11-f45.text: II oyoq-qöl ulanişini qayd qiliş uçun elektrokardiografning manfiy qutbi öng qölga, musbat qutbi esa çap oyoqqa ulanadi. Şuning uçun öng qöl çap oyoqqa nisbatan manfiy bölganda elektrokardiograf musbat qayd etadi.

ch11-f46.text: III oyoq-qöl ulanişini qayd qiliş uçun elektrokardiografning manfiy qutbi çap qölga, musbat qutbi esa çap oyoqqa ulanadi. Bu ulaniş çap qöl çap oyoqqa nisbatan manfiy bölganda elektrokardiograf musbat qayd etişini anglatadi.

ch11-f47.text: **Rasm 11-6** da yurak sohasi atrofida _Eyntxoven uçburçagi_ deb ataladigan uçburçak çizilgan. Bu uçburçak ikki qöl va çap oyoq yurakni örab turgan uçburçakning uçlarini hosil qilişini körsatadi. Uçburçakning yuqori qismidagi ikki uçi ikki qöl yurak atrofidagi suyuqliklar bilan elektr jihatdan tutaşadigan nuqtalarni, pastki uçi esa çap oyoq suyuqliklar bilan tutaşadigan nuqtani bildiradi.

ch11-f48.text: Eyntxoven qonuniga köra, agar EKG uçta oyoq-qöl ulanişida bir vaqtda qayd qilinsa, I va III ulanişlarda qayd qilingan potensiallar yiğindisi II ulanişdagi potensialga teng böladi:

ch11-f49.text: Boşqaça aytganda, agar istalgan paytda uçta bipolyar oyoq-qöl elektrokardiografik ulanişlaridan istalgan ikkitasining elektr potensiallari ma’lum bölsa, uçinçisini dastlabki ikkitasini şunçaki qöşiş orqali aniqlaş mumkin. Biroq e’tibor bering: bu qöşişni bajarişda turli ulanişlarning musbat va manfiy işoralariga rioya qiliş kerak.

ch11-f50.text: Masalan, **Rasm 11-6** da körsatilganidek, ayni paytda öng qöl tanadagi örtaça potensialga nisbatan −0,2 millivolt (manfiy),

ch11-f51.text: çap qöl +0,3 millivolt (musbat), çap oyoq esa +1,0 millivolt (musbat) bölsin, deb faraz qilaylik. Rasmdagi ölçov asboblariga qarab, I ulaniş +0,5 millivoltlik musbat potensialni qayd qilişini köriş mumkin, çunki bu öng qöldagi −0,2 millivolt bilan çap qöldagi +0,3 millivolt örtasidagi farqdir. Xuddi şunday, III ulaniş +0,7 millivoltlik, II ulaniş esa +1,2 millivoltlik musbat potensialni qayd qiladi, çunki bular tegişli oyoq-qöl juftlari örtasidagi ayni paytdagi potensiallar farqidir.

ch11-f52.text: Endi e’tibor bering: I va III ulanişlardagi voltajlar yiğindisi II ulanişdagi voltajga teng, ya’ni 0,5 qöşuv 0,7 teng 1,2. Matematik jihatdan Eyntxoven qonuni deb ataladigan bu tamoyil uçta “standart” bipolyar EKG qayd qilinayotgan istalgan paytda örinli böladi.

ch11-f53.text: **Rasm 11-7** da I, II va III ulanişlardagi EKG yozuvlari körsatilgan. Bu uç ulanişdagi EKGlar bir-biriga öxşaşligi aniq körinib turibdi, çunki ularning hammasida musbat P tişçalari va musbat T tişçalari qayd qilingan, har bir EKGda QRS kompleksining asosiy qismi ham musbat. Uçala EKG tahlil qilinganda, sinçkovlik bilan ölçaş va qutblarga töğri rioya qiliş orqali istalgan paytda I va III ulanişlardagi potensiallar yiğindisi II ulanişdagi potensialga teng ekanini körsatiş mumkin; bu Eyntxoven qonunining töğriligini tasdiqlaydi.
ch11-f53.lead: Uçta standart bipolyar oyoq-qöl ulanişidan qayd qilingan normal elektrokardiogrammalar.

ch11-f55.text: Barça bipolyar oyoq-qöl ulanişlaridagi yozuvlar bir-biriga öxşaş bölgani uçun turli yurak aritmiyalarini taşxislaşda qaysi ulaniş qayd qilinişi unçalik muhim emas, çunki aritmiyalar taşxisi asosan yurak siklining turli tişçalari örtasidagi vaqt munosabatlariga asoslanadi. Biroq qorinça yoki bölmaça muskulining yoxud Purkinye ötkazuvçi tizimining şikastlanişini taşxislaş kerak bölganda qaysi ulanişlar qayd qilinişi juda muhim, çunki yurak muskuli qisqarişi yoki yurak impulsi ötkazilişidagi buzilişlar ba’zi ulanişlarda EKG şaklini keskin özgartiradi, boşqalariga esa ta’sir qilmasligi mumkin. Bu ikki turdagi holatlar — kardiomiopatiyalar va yurak aritmiyalarining elektrokardiografik talqini 12- va 13-boblarda alohida muhokama qilinadi.

ch11-f56.text: Köpinça EKG bitta elektrodni kökrak qafasining old yuzasiga bevosita yurak ustiga, **Rasm 11-8** da körsatilgan nuqtalardan biriga qöyib qayd qilinadi. Bu elektrod elektrokardiografning musbat qutbiga ulanadi, _indifferent elektrod_ yoki _Vilsonning markaziy terminali_ deb ataladigan manfiy elektrod esa rasmda körsatilganidek, bir xil elektr qarşiliklar orqali bir vaqtning özida öng qöl, çap qöl va çap oyoqqa ulanadi. Odatda kökrak qafasining old devoridan oltita standart kökrak ulanişi navbatma-navbat qayd qilinadi; bunda kökrak elektrodi sxemada körsatilgan oltita nuqtaga ketma-ket qöyiladi. Turli yozuvlar V1, V2, V3, V4, V5 va V6 ulanişlar deb ataladi.

ch11-f58.text: **Rasm 11-9** da soğlom yurakning şu oltita standart kökrak ulanişidan qayd qilingan EKGlari tasvirlangan. Yurak yuzalari kökrak devoriga yaqin joylaşgani uçun har bir kökrak ulanişi asosan bevosita elektrod ostida joylaşgan yurak muskulining elektr potensialini qayd qiladi. Şuning uçun qorinçalardagi, ayniqsa qorinçalarning old devoridagi nisbatan juda kiçik buzilişlar ham alohida kökrak ulanişlaridan qayd qilingan EKGlarda sezilarli özgarişlarga sabab bölişi mumkin.

ch11-f60.text: V1 va V2 ulanişlarda normal yurakning QRS yozuvlari asosan manfiy böladi, çunki **Rasm 11-8** da körsatilganidek, bu ulanişlardagi kökrak elektrodi yurak çöqqisidan köra yurak asosiga yaqinroq joylaşgan, qorinçalar depolyarizatsiyasi jarayonining katta qismida esa elektromanfiylik yurak asosi tomonga yönalgan böladi. Aksinça, V4, V5 va V6 ulanişlarda QRS komplekslari asosan musbat, çunki bu ulanişlardagi kökrak elektrodi depolyarizatsiyaning katta qismida elektromusbatlik yönalgan yurak çöqqisiga yaqinroq joylaşgan.

ch11-f62.text: Keng qöllaniladigan yana bir ulanişlar tizimi — _kuçaytirilgan oyoq-qöl ulanişlari_. Bunday qayd qilişda oyoq-qöllardan ikkitasi elektr qarşiliklar orqali elektrokardiografning manfiy qutbiga, uçinçisi esa musbat qutbiga ulanadi. Musbat qutb öng qölda bölganda ulaniş aVR, çap qölda bölganda aVL, çap oyoqda bölganda esa aVF ulaniş deb ataladi.

ch11-f63.text: Kuçaytirilgan oyoq-qöl ulanişlarining normal yozuvlari **Rasm 11-10** da körsatilgan. Ularning hammasi standart oyoq-qöl ulanişlari yozuvlariga öxşaydi, faqat aVR ulanişdagi yozuv teskari (inversiyalangan) böladi. (Nima uçun bunday inversiya yuz beradi? Bu savolga javob topiş uçun elektrokardiografga ulaniş qutblarini örganib çiqing.)

ch11-f65.text: Ulanişlar odatda **Rasm 11-11** dagidek uç guruhda tasvirlanadi: standart bipolyar oyoq-qöl ulanişlari (I, II, III), söngra kuçaytirilgan ulanişlar (aVR, aVL va aVF) va undan keyin prekardial (kökrak) ulanişlari (V1–V6).

ch11-f66.text: Standart EKG yurakdagi elektr hodisalarini qisqa vaqt davomida, odatda bemor tinç holatda bölganda baholaş imkonini beradi. Yurak ritmining kamdan-kam uçraydigan, ammo muhim buzilişlari bilan keçadigan holatlarda EKGni uzoqroq vaqt davomida tekşiriş foydali bölişi mumkin; bu ötkinçi bölgan va standart tinç holatdagi EKGda ötkazib yuborilişi mumkin bölgan özgaruvçan yurak elektr hodisalarini baholaşga imkon beradi. Bemor odatdagi kundalik faoliyati davomida yurib yurgan paytda yurakdagi elektr hodisalarini baholaş uçun EKGni uzaytirib qayd qiliş _ambulator elektrokardiografiya_ deb ataladi.

ch11-f67.text: Ambulator elektrokardiografik monitoring odatda bemorda ötkinçi aritmiyalar yoki yurakning boşqa ötkinçi buzilişlari tufayli yuzaga keladi, deb taxmin qilinadigan belgilar kuzatilganda qöllaniladi. Bu belgilar kökrakdagi oğriq, sinkope (huşdan ketiş) yoki huşdan ketiş arafasidagi holat, boş aylanişi va yurakning notekis urişi (yurak öynaşi, palpitatsiya) bölişi mumkin. Jiddiy ötkinçi aritmiyalar yoki yurakning boşqa holatlarini taşxislaş uçun zarur bölgan hal qiluvçi ma’lumot — aynan belgi yuzaga kelayotgan paytda yozib olingan EKG. Bu qurilmalar bölmaçalar fibrillyatsiyasi kabi belgisiz keçadigan yurak aritmiyalarini aniqlaş uçun ham işlatilişi mumkin; bunday aritmiyalar embol hosil bölişi xavfini oşirişi, bu esa öz navbatida insultlarga sabab bölişi mumkin. Aritmiyalar çastotasining kunlik özgaruvçanligi katta bölgani uçun ularni aniqlaş köpinça kun böyi ambulator elektrokardiografik monitoringni talab qiladi.

ch11-f68.text: Ambulator elektrokardiografik qayd qiluvçi qurilmalarning bir neça toifasi mavjud. Uzluksiz qayd qiluvçi qurilmalar (Xolter monitorlari) odatda 24–48 soat davomida şu vaqt oraliğida yuz berişi ehtimoli bölgan belgilar bilan elektrokardiografik hodisalar örtasidagi boğliqlikni tekşiriş uçun qöllaniladi. Davriy qayd qiluvçi qurilmalar kamdan-kam yuz beradigan hodisalarni aniqlaş maqsadida qisqa davriy yozuvlarni oliş uçun uzoqroq muddat (haftalardan oylargaça) qöllaniladi; bu yozuvlarni odatda bemor belgilarni sezganda özi işga tuşiradi. Ba’zi hollarda katta qoğoz qisqiçi ölçamidagi, _implantatsiya qilinadigan halqali (loop) qayd qiluvçi qurilma_ deb ataladigan kiçik moslama yurakning elektr faolligini 2–3 yilgaça uzluksiz kuzatib boriş uçun kökrak sohasida teri ostiga joylaştiriladi. Qurilmani yurak uriş çastotasi oldindan belgilangan darajadan pastga tuşganda yoki undan oşganda yozuvni boşlaşga dasturlaş mumkin, şuningdek boş aylanişi kabi belgi paydo bölganda bemor uni qölda işga tuşirişi mumkin. Qattiq jismli raqamli texnologiyalarning takomillaşuvi va mikroprotsessorlar bilan jihozlangan qayd qiluvçi qurilmalar endi raqamli elektrokardiografik ma’lumotlarni telefon liniyalari orqali uzluksiz yoki davriy uzatiş imkonini beradi, murakkab dasturiy tizimlar esa ma’lumotlarni olinişi bilanoq tezkor onlayn kompyuter tahlilini ta’minlaydi. Uyda yurak ritmini kuzatiş uçun yangi kiyiladigan qurilmalar, jumladan soatlar yoki qölda uşlanadigan elektrokardiografik monitoring qurilmalari ham işlab çiqilmoqda.
